testResults.name: ui-build-and-tests
testResults.command: cd src/ui && npm run build && npm run test -- run && npx svelte-check
testResults.result: adapter-static build succeeds (SPA fallback verified on / and /w/alpha-lab/chats); 18 vitest tests pass (workspace switcher re-scoping, SSE resume/dedup, consent card free-text rejection, backtest split declared/not-declared, capability unavailable surfaces, screener save); svelte-check 0 errors 0 warnings

testResults.name: spec-implementation-inventory
testResults.result: All eight spec pages implemented under /w/[workspace]/ (overview, chats, strategies+detail with lineage, backtests+detail with IS/OOS split and not-declared state, deployments with orders/risk, dashboards with artifact-backed widgets, screener with saved studies, workspace-state with CLEO projection/lineage/evidence/consent-audit) plus the app shell (switcher, command palette, copilot panel), chat SSE client with Last-Event-ID resume and ephemeral dedup, structured consent card, and a fixture/real dual-mode typed API layer (21 fixture documents, two workspaces for re-scoping)

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
